tools.name: bsi_get_scoreboard
tools.description: Get college baseball scores and game results returned by the configured providers. Includes team names, scores, venue, game status, source, and fetch time.

tools.name: bsi_get_standings
tools.description: Get current college baseball conference standings including wins, losses, win percentage, runs scored, runs allowed, run differential, streak, and games back.

tools.name: bsi_get_rankings
tools.description: Get the national college baseball Top 25 returned by the rankings source. Includes rank, team, record, movement, source, and fetch time.

tools.name: bsi_get_player_stats
tools.description: Search supported source records for a college baseball player by name. Returns identity, team, position, and traditional batting or pitching stats when the source provides them.

tools.name: bsi_get_team_schedule
tools.description: Get schedule records returned for a college baseball team, including past results and upcoming games when the source provides them.

tools.name: bsi_get_match_detail
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific college baseball game including venue, weather, win predictions, play-by-play, and team stats. Use a match ID from the scoreboard.

tools.name: bsi_search_intel
tools.description: Search the open web for college-baseball news, scouting reports, beat-writer coverage, and analytical commentary. Use this when a question needs narrative context. Defaults to trusted college-baseball domains and returns the provider in response metadata.
